PH 1. PC6-061 – Vista Grande Annexation – Omni Financial, LLC
Recommended Action:
A Mitigated Negative Declaration, request for an Annexation/Reorganization, Zone change/assignment of a pre-zoning designation for two parcels, and a Tentative Subdivision Map for a 14-lot single family residential subdivision located on Vista Grande Drive (APN's 171-100-05-00 and 171-100-28-00).*3
Staff Report
PH 2. P16-0032 – Vista Melrose 47 – Warmington Residential
Recommended Action:
Request for a Mitigated Negative Declaration, General Plan Amendment, Zone Change, Site Development Plan, Condominium Housing Permit, and Tentative Subdivision Map, to develop a 47 unit condominium development to include open space amenities, landscaping, and associated improvements on a 3.14 acre site located at 1630 S. Melrose Drive. The project site is currently developed with a church that was formerly occupied by the First Church of Christ Scientist. The project proposes 9 three story condominium buildings, parking facilities, open space amenities, pedestrian walkways, and associated site improvements.
